note: Only shown as the %s of E0158 (table 0x800DE29C, sole user sprintf at 0x8002A184 -> '%s: none'). Mirrors the category names E0562-E0564 (Weapons / Support / Healing); 'Support Items' (71 px) does not fit the 48 px table estimate.
Same as E0151: only shown as the %s of E0158 ('Healing: none').
Column header; %s = item category from table 0x800DE290 (E0562-E0564: weapons / support / healing).
Empty-slot dashes: 12 ASCII hyphens (60 px) for the 6 full-width dashes.
Worded like E0150 (which keeps 'in storage': 'in the storehouse' does not fit there). [gaps pass 2026-10-28, I-03: was "No items in storage."] [proof: note]

en:
No one is left here
who can spar with
any of you.

You have no weapon
equipped, so you
cannot train.

A wager is needed
for each opponent.

At times, one
must pull back...

Running away is
part of strategy too.

It's a draw, so I'll
return your wager.

There's no one here
who can match you
anymore.
Please, spare us further bouts.

In a real battle,
you'd have died.

If you'd permit me,
may I ask your name?
note: A swordsman met at the training ground asks the player's officer.

en:
Then you must be
with the Mouri...
note: Trailing line break kept as in the Japanese.

en:
What do you say?
Would you let me
come along too?

Lord Motonari,
what shall we do?

note: Glossary caption form "X joined your army." without the period: 85 px > 84 with it (same exception as U02131 / U03524).

en:
This has been in
my family for
generations.

May it be of some
use to you.

A pity, but it
cannot be
helped.

In that case,
may this be of
some use to you.

Your spirit was
enough to beat me.
I'm humbled.

By the look of it,
you're in some
sort of trouble.

If you like, I'll
lend you my aid.

Lord Motonari,
what will you do?

Oh, that's right.
May this be of
some use to you.

note: [edit: 'too.' stranded on its own balloon line; contraction for spoken voice]

en:
...Ah, yes.
Let me give
you this.

note: Glossary stat names, caption with a period.
"%s's attack missed." is 85 px > 84; the attacker is the subject, so the meaning is kept.
The comma pause of the Japanese kept as "...".
%s = item that could not be kept. [gaps pass 2026-10-28, I-48: was "Gave up %s."]
Clan name (glossary: Chosokabe Motochika). 53 px > 48 (estimate from the Japanese table width; the real column width is unknown). A proper name can't be cut: left, flagged.
